exports.name: MessageComponent
exports.summary:
Dismissible inline message/banner with a label, optional sublabel/icon, and a collapse
animation on open/close.
exports.summaryZh: 可关闭的行内消息/横幅，带标题、可选副标题/图标，展开/收起时带折叠动画。

inputs.name: label
inputs.description:
label: string

Sets the label of the message.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `label`（类型：`string`），用于配置标签。

inputs.name: sublabel
inputs.description:
sublabel?: string

Sets the sublabel of the message.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `sublabel`（类型：`string`），用于配置副标签。

inputs.name: color
inputs.description:
The message's theme color; `primary`/`accent`/`warn` apply Material theme classes,
any other value is used directly as a color-name-based background/text class pair.
inputs.descriptionZh:
消息的主题色；`primary`/`accent`/`warn` 会应用 Material 主题类，
其他值会被直接用作基于颜色名称的背景/文字类名。

inputs.name: opened
inputs.description:
opened?: boolean

Shows or hiddes the message depending on its value.
Defaults to 'true'.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `opened` 的设置器，用于更新是否展开。

methods.name: animationDoneListener
methods.description:
Detach element when close animation is finished to set animating state to false
hidden state to true and detach element from DOM
methods.descriptionZh: 宿主事件监听方法 `animationDoneListener`，响应 `@duiCollapse.done` 事件以处理动画完成监听器。

methods.name: open
methods.description:
Renders the message on screen
Validates if there is an animation currently and if its already opened

methods.name: close
methods.description:
Removes the message content from screen.
Validates if there is an animation currently and if its already closed

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between open and close depending on state.

properties.name: collapsedAnimation
properties.descriptionZh: 宿主绑定读取器 `collapsedAnimation`（绑定至 `@duiCollapse`），计算并返回已折叠动画。

properties.name: hidden
properties.description: Binding host to display style when hidden
properties.descriptionZh: 宿主绑定读取器 `hidden`（绑定至 `style.display`），计算并返回隐藏。

properties.name: opened
properties.description: Whether the message is currently open (visible).
properties.descriptionZh: 消息当前是否处于展开（可见）状态。

exports.name: MessageContainerDirective
exports.summaryZh: 内部使用，标记 {@link MessageComponent} 用于延迟挂载内容的视图容器锚点。

exports.name: MessageModule
exports.summary: Angular module `MessageModule` declaring and exporting message module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `MessageModule`，声明并导出消息模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。
